basics.description: Deploy DeltaForge on Azure as a self-contained per-tier slot pool: a Platform Container App (control plane plus the always-on embedded compute node), a PostgreSQL flexible server catalog, ADLS Gen2 blob plus premium NFS storage, two Key Vaults, and a pool of idle compute slots that scale 0 to 1 on demand. Passwords and the license key are stored in Key Vault; the node auto-bootstraps the seeded accounts on first boot.

options.text: Leave the license key blank to auto-provision a free Community license on first boot: the platform proves this Azure subscription to the DeltaForge console and receives a key automatically, so you do not need to register first. Paste a key only to pin a purchased or higher tier.

basics.name: licenseKey
basics.label: DeltaForge license key (optional)
basics.toolTip: Your DeltaForge license token. Leave blank to auto-provision a Community license from your Azure subscription. When supplied, it is stored as a secret in the deployment Key Vault and read by the platform at boot.

constraints.validationMessage: Leave blank to auto-provision, or enter a license key of at least 8 characters.

basics.name: namePrefix
basics.label: Resource name prefix
basics.toolTip: Short prefix used to name every resource (lowercase, must start with a letter, 3 to 16 characters). A globally-unique suffix is appended automatically.

constraints.validationMessage: Lowercase only, must start with a letter, 3 to 16 characters.

basics.name: adminEmail
basics.label: Admin account email
basics.toolTip: Email address for the seeded administrator account created on first boot.

basics.name: engineerEmail
basics.label: Engineer account email
basics.toolTip: Email address for the seeded engineer account created on first boot.

basics.name: adminPassword
basics.toolTip: Password for the seeded administrator account. Stored in Key Vault and wired to the platform as DELTA_FORGE_ADMIN_PASSWORD.

basics.name: engineerPassword
basics.toolTip: Password for the seeded engineer account. Stored in Key Vault and wired to the platform as DELTA_FORGE_ENGINEER_PASSWORD.

options.text: A managed Azure Database for PostgreSQL flexible server hosts the DeltaForge catalog. Choose a tier and SKU that match the chosen tier family, then set the administrator password.

elements.name: pgAdminPassword
elements.toolTip: Administrator password for the PostgreSQL flexible server. Stored in Key Vault and used to build the catalog connection string.

elements.name: pgTier
elements.label: PostgreSQL tier
elements.toolTip: Compute tier of the PostgreSQL flexible server. Burstable is the lowest cost; pick a SKU below that belongs to the same tier family.

elements.name: pgSkuName
elements.label: PostgreSQL SKU name
elements.toolTip: PostgreSQL flexible server SKU. Burstable SKUs start with Standard_B (e.g. Standard_B1ms); General Purpose start with Standard_D; Memory Optimized start with Standard_E.

constraints.validationMessage: Enter a valid PostgreSQL SKU, e.g. Standard_B1ms, Standard_D2s_v3, or Standard_E2s_v3.

elements.name: pgStorageGb
elements.label: PostgreSQL storage (GiB)
elements.toolTip: Provisioned storage for the PostgreSQL flexible server, in GiB.

constraints.validationMessage: Enter a whole number of GiB (minimum 32).

elements.name: dataShareGb
elements.label: /data NFS file share size (GiB)
elements.toolTip: Size of the premium NFS file share mounted at /data, in GiB. Premium minimum is 100; maximum is 102400.

constraints.validationMessage: Enter a whole number between 100 and 102400.

options.text: Leave the SMTP host blank to skip mailer setup (mail is logged instead of sent). You can configure email later from the console.

elements.name: smtpHost
elements.label: SMTP host
elements.toolTip: Hostname of your SMTP server. Leave blank to disable outbound email.

constraints.validationMessage: Enter a valid hostname or leave blank.

elements.name: smtpPort
elements.label: SMTP port
elements.toolTip: TCP port of the SMTP server (commonly 587 for STARTTLS or 465 for implicit TLS).

constraints.validationMessage: Enter a port number between 1 and 65535.

elements.name: smtpUsername
elements.label: SMTP username
elements.toolTip: Username for SMTP authentication. Leave blank if your relay does not require it.

elements.name: smtpPassword
elements.toolTip: Password for SMTP authentication. Stored in Key Vault when an SMTP host is configured.

elements.name: mailFrom
elements.label: From address
elements.toolTip: Envelope From address for outbound email. Defaults to the SMTP username when blank.

constraints.validationMessage: Enter a valid email address or leave blank.

elements.name: smtpStartTls
elements.label: Use STARTTLS
elements.toolTip: Enable STARTTLS when connecting to the SMTP server. Recommended for port 587.

options.text: Every field here has a working default. Override container images only for a private or air-gapped registry, and adjust sizing only if you understand the Azure Container Apps Consumption limits (0.25 to 4 vCPU).

elements.name: image
elements.label: Platform image
elements.toolTip: Fully-qualified DeltaForge Platform container image reference. Defaults to the published public image.

constraints.validationMessage: Enter a valid container image reference, e.g. ghcr.io/deltaforge-org/deltaforge-platform:latest.

elements.name: computeImage
elements.label: Compute (worker) image
elements.toolTip: Fully-qualified DeltaForge Compute container image run by every slot in the pool. Defaults to the published public image.

constraints.validationMessage: Enter a valid container image reference, e.g. ghcr.io/deltaforge-org/deltaforge-compute:latest.

elements.name: registryServer
elements.label: Registry login server
elements.toolTip: Private registry login server (e.g. myregistry.azurecr.io). Leave blank to pull the default public images.

constraints.validationMessage: Enter a valid registry host or leave blank.

elements.name: registryUsername
elements.label: Registry username
elements.toolTip: Username for the private registry. Only needed when a registry login server is set.

elements.name: registryPassword
elements.toolTip: Password or token for the private registry. Only needed when a registry login server is set.

elements.name: cpuCores
elements.label: Platform vCPU
elements.toolTip: vCPU allocated to the Platform container. Azure Container Apps Consumption supports 0.25 to 4 vCPU and the value must pair with memory.

elements.name: memory
elements.label: Platform memory
elements.toolTip: Memory allocated to the Platform container. Must pair with the chosen vCPU per the Azure Container Apps Consumption ratio.

elements.name: slotCpuCores
elements.label: Compute slot vCPU
elements.toolTip: vCPU allocated to each compute slot container. Azure Container Apps Consumption supports 0.25 to 4 vCPU and the value must pair with slot memory.

elements.name: slotMemory
elements.label: Compute slot memory
elements.toolTip: Memory allocated to each compute slot container. Must pair with the chosen slot vCPU per the Azure Container Apps Consumption ratio.

elements.name: scalingCredentialRef
elements.label: Scaling credential reference
elements.toolTip: Vault entry id holding the Azure service-principal credential the provisioner uses to flip slot replicas via ARM. Leave blank at deploy time and add it post-deploy per README-slot-pool.md.
